The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Prime Poultry Curry}}
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Prime Poultry Curry is made by [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Bird Thigh]], [[Goron Spice]], and [[Hylian Rice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Eating them will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The flavor of these curries comes from adding the spices after they have been taken off the heat. Link can use additional [[Ingredient]]s when making these curries, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. These curries will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Poultry Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Consuming them will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Poultry Curry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. Link can eat these curries to have his [[Stamina Wheel]] partially refilled. * '''Hasty Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Poultry Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. Eating these will increase Link's [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Spicy Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Prime Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The secret to this curry's flavor is taking it off the heat while you add the spices.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Link will gain a boost to his [[Defense]] by eating these curries. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Poultry Curry * Meal * Poultry Curry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
